messages:
sam_sales: FYI - Prospect (Northpoint) asked for a quick POC. Requirements: SAML2 SSO, SCIM for ~180k users, group->role mapping, multi-domain proofing, and data residency constraints. Can we confirm blockers and next steps?

ivan_se: SE notes: they want delegated tenant admins and RBAC derived from IdP groups. Need audit trail for admin role changes.

tara_sme: SCIM plan: bulk seed + deltas every 5m. Hosted default throttle 20 rps; for Dedicated we can lift to 200 rps and enable batch import. We support externalId, groups, and a custom attr for role level.

maria_sec: Security asks: BYOK KMS, SOC2 Type II, 24mo audit log retention, cert rotation cadence (recommend 90 days). We never auto-delete on transient SCIM failures; deletions require explicit signal.

leo_devops: Dedicated supports customer KMS (AWS/Azure/GCP), VPC peering, and SIEM forwarding over HTTPS. Domain proofing uses TXT tokens per FQDN like `_redwood_verify=NP-xxxxx`. Token rotation quarterly supported.

nina_pricing: Pricing implications: Dedicated + private control plane moves to enterprise tier. Ballpark base reserved capacity $30k-$40k/mo; final depends on QPS/concurrency. I'll draft two scenarios.

ops_bot: Please attach their security questionnaire so team can pre-fill standard answers.

sam_sales: Uploaded SQ here: https://redwood.app/drive/northpoint/sq.pdf (placeholder). Action items: Tara -> SCIM examples, Maria -> security one-pager, Leo -> sizing options, Nina -> draft pricing. Target to send artifacts today and schedule IdP dry-run Wed 10am PT.

tara_sme: Posting sample SCIM create payload and group mapping snippet to the drive.

maria_sec: I'll annotate the questionnaire with KMS, encryption, logging, and rotation details.

ivan_se: SEs will join the dry-run. Recommend validating Okta mapping ahead to avoid schema mismatches.

sam_sales: Thanks team. Will collect buyer concurrency numbers and reopen thread if needed.
